content.description:
I am seeking a Mechanical Engineering Intern for my facility in Taloja MIDC. As an intern, you will support the technical team and be responsible for assigned projects in a dynamic cold storage environment. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in mechanical systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency. Candidates must be willing to commute to Taloja MIDC.
If you're looking to enhance your practical skills and are ready for a challenging yet rewarding experience, apply now!
